subject: Cross-org pre-demo: align pricing, sizing & procurement availability
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Cross-org pre-demo: align pricing, sizing & procurement availability

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for booking the demo next week. Before the full demo we find a short cross-org sync (30–45m) very helpful so we come in aligned on:

- expected monthly usage forecast (qps/concurrent sessions and average sequence length)
- whether you want a Dedicated pool or Hosted with burst capacity
- procurement timeline and any contract must-haves (CSP terms, data residency)
- security requirements/security questionnaire touchpoints

Proposed outcome: a one-page mutual action plan and a sizing workbook we can bring to the demo so SEs can run two right-sized configurations live.

Could you confirm who from Procurement and Security should join? Below are two windows we have available (PST):

- Tue Apr 13 11:00–11:45
- Wed Apr 14 09:30–10:15

I attached a draft_sizing.xlsx and a 1-page proposed_agenda.pdf to speed the sync. If neither slot works, share a couple of times and we’ll work around Procurement.

Thanks — I’ll ask Marcus to prepare an estimated cost delta table (Hosted vs Dedicated) for the usage bands you share.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment(s): draft_sizing.xlsx (xlsx), proposed_agenda.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-org pre-demo: align pricing, sizing & procurement availability

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the proactive note. Procurement will need to be on the call (looping them in). Tom from Security should also attend to validate our infosec checklist. Procurement asked for a copy of the commercial terms we typically include for Dedicated (or option to start hosted + reserved burst) and any standard SOW templates. Can you share those ahead of time?

We’re generally available:
- Wed Apr 14 09:30 PT works for our team (matching your option)
- If that fills up, Thu Apr 15 08:00 PT is also possible (we prefer mornings)

Also, FYI on rough forecast so Marcus can size: approx 2000 monthly active users, peak concurrency ~140, average sequence length ~250 tokens.

Elena Ruiz
Senior Cloud Engineer — Infrastructure
Acme Corp
elena.ruiz@acme.com

Thanks, Elena — Wed Apr 14 09:30 PT is locked. I’ve put a 45-minute slot on the calendar and included a short agenda item list. Evelyn (Security & Compliance) will join to walk through our SOC2 scope and what we can provide for your security team.

Ben, can you have the commercial terms packet + SOW template ready to share before the call (commercial_terms_request.docx)? Karthik, feel free to add anything for legal/ops we should proactively discuss.

Marcus — based on Elena’s initial numbers (2k MAU, 140 peak concurrent, 250 tokens avg), can you prep two sizing options for the meeting:
1) Hosted with burst to Dedicated equivalent (cost delta table + latency expectations)
2) Dedicated 2x configuration (primary + warm spare) with monthly committed throughput and pricing bands

I’ll update the mutual action plan doc live during the meeting so Procurement has clear next steps.

See you all Wed 09:30 PT — calendar invite sent.

Best,
Soojin

Subject: RE: Cross-org pre-demo: align pricing, sizing & procurement availability

Soojin — quick technical note ahead of tomorrow:

Thanks for the forecast. To make the sizing deterministic I want to confirm two details if you can ask Elena:
1) Sequence length distribution — is the 250 token figure median or mean? Any long-tail cases hitting 1k+ tokens?
2) Percent of requests that require tool-calls or function-calling (these increase effective compute per request)

I’ll prepare a cost table that shows per-10k-token unit costs and an expected monthly bill for both Hosted and Dedicated (including cache/kv benefits). If we have the distribution I’ll include a more accurate latency curve for 95th pct.

Also setting up a quick sanity runbook for the demo to show both configs side-by-side without cross-contamination.

— Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Hi all —

Thanks, that time worked. Quick answers for Marcus: the 250 tokens is an average (mean) — typical distribution has a 75th pct ~480 tokens and about ~2% of calls spike above 1k. Function-calls are rare (~1% of total).

Procurement requested the commercial terms packet and a visible SOW template ahead of the demo (they want to assign internal reviewers same day). I’ve uploaded a short procurement intake here: https://acme.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/intake/7834 and flagged the items they care about (data residency, termination clauses, liability caps).

If you can share the commercial_terms_request.docx and SOW template via the Drive link before the meeting, Procurement will do a quick read and come with a list of non-negotiables.

Looking forward to the session.

Elena
